caption: The drawing, rendered in black ink on a beige background, features a symmetrical, vertically oriented central motif framed by double rectangular borders with an additional internal border that encapsulates an abstract design. The central structure is composed of stylized, geometric vegetal forms resembling leaves and draped fabric, with an upper section that is arch-shaped and flanked by vertical columns ending in ornate bases. The topmost area presents an arrangement of fan-like and curled leaf shapes. Draped elements hang from the upper rectangular component, which is supported by columns. To the right of this main motif, two detailed sketches display fragments labeled "Front of Arm" and "Top of Arm." The "Front of Arm" sketch shows a section with a circular rosette design featuring petal-like shapes radiating from the center, while "Top of Arm" depicts curved, grooved forms resembling leaves or stylized feathers. Both arm sketches are shown as if segments cut out from a larger ornamental structure. The entire composition is line-based with cross-hatching and stippling for tonal variation, and all lines are uniformly black in color. The artist's signature "N. Souis" is present in the bottom right corner.
title: Armchair
